description: This file defines configuration and helper functions for authentication in a frontend application, including API URL, salt management, local storage handling, and authentication status checks.

methods.name: getStoredAuth
methods.description: Retrieves and parses authentication data from local storage.

methods.name: saveAuthSession
methods.description: Saves authentication token data to local storage.

methods.name: clearAuthSession
methods.description: Removes authentication data from local storage.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently authenticated based on stored data.
